diagnostic.probe_scope: one-second unauthenticated TCP connect and up-to-256-byte SSH banner read from the explicitly configured loopback endpoint

doctor.observed: manager=runit; service=ternuxx-sshd; status=running; config syntax=valid; loopback SSH probe=ssh_banner; listener ownership=unverified

limitations: An SSH banner proves an SSH protocol endpoint accepted a loopback connection; it does not prove that the Runit-owned PID owns the listener.
The probe is unauthenticated and is not a substitute for the separate password-authenticated probe recorded in postboot evidence.
No package, service, desktop, boot profile, or PRoot state was changed.
